name: XCC_CONTROL_BUDGET_ERRORS
description: This table stores the processing errors encountered during the control budget creation.

columns.name: ERROR_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the error for each row.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_NAME
columns.description: Unique identifier of the control budget.

columns.name: ERROR_CODE
columns.description: Error code to identity errors during the validation phase of each control budget.

columns.name: ERROR_TOKENS
columns.description: Error message tokens to replace the token values in the actual message text.

columns.name: IMPORT_DATA_SET_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier to call the control budget import process.

columns.name: PROJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the accounting project. The default value is -98.

columns.name: PJC_CONTRACT_ID
columns.description: Unique project accounting contract identifier for the award associated with the budget amount. The default value is -98.

columns.name: OBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique object identifier for internal use by Project Portfolio Management and U.S. Federal Financials.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: TOKEN1_NAME
columns.description: First token name in the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN2_NAME
columns.description: Second token name in the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN3_NAME
columns.description: Third token name in the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN4_NAME
columns.description: Fourth token name in the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN5_NAME
columns.description: Fifth token name in the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN1_VALUE
columns.description: First token value of the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN2_VALUE
columns.description: Second token value of the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN3_VALUE
columns.description: Third token value of the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN4_VALUE
columns.description: Fourth token value of the error message.

columns.name: TOKEN5_VALUE
columns.description: Fifth token value of the error message.

columns.name: CALLING_PRODUCT_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Product line code that initiaties the creation of control budget.For example,PPM or FV.
